notes.title: Content update 2 - Contracts - Now live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello board members![/p][p][/p][p]We are excited to announce the next major update for Rise of Industry 2 - The Contract update![/p][p][/p][p]This update aims to help you maximize profits with new types of domestic and international contracts, alongside tidying up some paperwork so you can spend more time being the influential business tycoon that you are.
[/p][p]So what are these contracts I hear you ask?
[/p][p]New Domestic contracts:[/p][p]Domestic contracts were very similar to one another. Now suppliers and buyers will occasionally negotiate further. This can range from a simple signing bonus, to a change in terms such as increased production or different materials entirely. [/p][p]If you can meet their requirements, they will reward you with better terms to sweeten the deal. Make sure you don’t fail though, as repercussions will follow swiftly and your reputation will be tarnished. Be careful however, not every relationship will be smooth sailing.
[/p][p]International contracts:[/p][p]As you grow from a small grassroots company to an industrial empire, making waves across the business world, your company is destined to get noticed.  You can now trade outside of the states after dominating domestically.[/p][p]Construct a new International Trade complex, send your VP of sales overseas, and expand your grip on the market after establishing your presence as a true tycoon.[/p][p]These come with their own considerations. Travel and transport take time, so negotiations and deliveries will take longer, however, you can freely control how much is being delivered or sold.
[/p][p]Critical events:[/p][p]Certain critical events will now require immediate attention. Your board of executives is not going to allow you to hide behind your desk anymore and will demand action if a decision isn’t made.
[/p][p]New Shortcuts:[/p][p]No business mogul should have to sift through paperwork to find what they want, that's what your staff is for! To rectify this, you can now jump from the build menu to the appropriate production manual page with a brand new shortcut.[/p][p][/p][p]Collapsing notifications:[/p][p]Previously notifications could build up rapidly and hide important events. To make sure you are only seeing what matters, some notifications are now collapsible![/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog:[/b][/p][p][b]Version 1.2.0[/b][/p][p]Major Updates:
[/p][p]- Some events will now force you to make choices - there's a countdown on the notification and when it expires, you will need to choose what to do in order to proceed[/p][p]- Added a direct link from the build menu to the production manual. While in build, if you shift click or use the indicated controller button, it will open the relevant page in the production manual so that you can see what is required to build and operate the building[/p][p]- Some contracts will now make requests prior to signing. Some will offer signing bonuses, require fees to be paid, or ask you to complete specific missions to get the contract. These will impact the contract once it's active.[/p][p]- International agreements:[/p][p]    - Upon reaching some thresholds for corporate size and complexity, you can send your VP of Sales to seek an international presence[/p][p]    - On completing a mission to establish the international presence, you can negotiate international contracts[/p][p]    - International contracts allow players to buy and sell any amount desired via an international contract[/p][p]    - There's a new complex for international trade and contracts[/p][p]- Minor notifications for things like contract delivery, building function and other non-critical items will collapse into stacks for those that trigger on the next day. This should reduce the number of notifications in the top left[/p][p]- New, optional tutorial added to explain some additional items:[/p][p]    - VP hiring and management[/p][p]    - Land management[/p][p]    - Utility management and usage[/p][p]    - Technology[/p][p]    - Worker happiness and city interactions[/p][p][/p][p]Minor changes and bug fixes:[/p][p][/p][p]More refinements to controller support and function[/p][p]- \[BUG FIX] Snow in some maps was shown as hexagon shapes[/p][p]- \[BUG FIX] Trains will now appear for all resources when contracts are fulfilled by rail[/p][p]- \[BUG FIX] Mission in Peoria was repeating constantly[/p][p]- \[BUG FIX] Some contract unlocks were referencing incorrect contract completion requirements[/p][p]- \[BUG FIX] EPA choice was not granting the chimney filters tech[/p][p]- \[BUG FIX] Housewares complex was showing up in the tutorial build menu[/p][p]- \[BUG FIX] A few typos and some rewording for clarity[/p]

notes.title: Content Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello board members![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your continued support since launch. We’ve listened closely to your feedback (and reviewed our own) to identify the biggest challenge facing our intrepid entrepreneurs. The result?[/p][p]Rise of Industry 2’s first major content update![/p][p]So, what’s changed?
[/p][p][b]New Feature - Construction Manager:[/b][/p][p]Have more oversight into the jobs of your builders and quickly adjust different project’s priorities as needed and jump between sites.[/p][p]Need something done as soon as possible? Push it to the top of your construction queue and freely move tasks up or down the list.
[/p][p][b]Improvement - Byproduct production:[/b][/p][p]The way that byproducts are calculated has been adjusted, to make it clearer what is being produced where and when. It should now reflect what is being output more realistically
[/p][p][b]New Feature - Contact management:[/b][/p][p]We heard your feedback with how contacts were made, maintained, and utilised. We agree that the way to navigate to your contacts and establish new connections can be quite difficult and overwhelming. As such, we have reworked the system. Reach out to other companies based on a target resource, link with new industry moguls via your employees, and network externally easier than before.
[/p][p][b]Improvement - Staff management:[/b][/p][p]You can now hire and assign VPs more easily, selecting the role you want them to fill, rather than rejecting them, or slotting them into a role they aren't suited for.
[/p][p][b]New Feature - Hotkeys:[/b][/p][p]You may be familiar with these already, but to make it simpler for you to navigate the intricate world of tycoon building, remappable hotkeys have now been added![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Fn_Wd8GzTKk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Changelog:[/b][/p][p][b]Version 1.1.0[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Construction Manager[/p][/*][*][p]Added hotkeys for the following tabs (F1-F9 respectively): VP/managers, Vendor relations, Contracts, Deliveries, Reports, Investors, Production Manual, Toggle land management, and Toggle deposits view.[/p][/*][*][p]Clarified Byproduct production to show the amount produced and how frequently.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new UI for Vendor relations[/p][list][*][p]All relations (Current and potential) are now sorted based on the resource they deal in[/p][/*][*][p]Socialize with existing partners who deal in a desired resource[/p][/*][*][p]Use existing contacts to introduce you to other industrialists with ease[/p][/*][*][p]Cold call new contacts for a chance to spread your influence[/p][/*][*][p]Companies can still be found through the existing company menu[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved hiring members to your board[/p][list][*][p]Hiring is initiated like normal.[/p][/*][*][p]The successful candidate can now be assigned to any vacant position[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added new socialisation options for other companies[/p][list][*][p]Brainstorm ideas to trade research for influence.[/p][/*][*][p]Conduct Facility tours, which allow you to gain large amounts of influence for a price[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Utility reports are now complex based. Daily capacity and usage allows for a clearer view of your factories needs.[/p][/*][*][p]Disconnected pipes, roads, and wires now have a separate visualization so breaks are clearer.[/p][/*][*][p]Limits can be set on pipe connections for sending/receiving[/p][/*][*][p]Various controller fixes and QoL updates[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the controller reticle[/p][/*][*][p]Some menus have updated visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Hops can now be moved with conveyors[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bug Fix] Sulfur mines were experiencing accidents too frequently[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bug Fix] Large game cartridge factory was unlocking based on cardboard, not cartridges[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bug Fix] Fixed incorrect resource in an investment goal, in St. Louis[/p][/*][*][p]Typo and localization fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.02 is now live, fixing contracts and more!
notes.content:
Hello fellow tycoons!

Thank you to everyone who has played Rise of Industry 2 since its release. We’re really humbled by your positive comments and we’re excited to see more players begin their entrepreneurial journey! We are aware of some issues that players are facing and we are pleased to confirm that Update 1.02 is now live and includes several important fixes and improvements alongside yesterday’s hotfix. 

[b]Here’s what we have fixed since the game’s release:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where contracts could no longer be created or changed.
[*] Autosave's are now permanent, and will no longer be overwritten when changing scenarios.
[*] The default graphics setting is now "High" rather than "Highest" to help with performance on some older GPUs.
[*] Frank's mission in Cleveland now correctly grants you the sulfur deposit he mentions (NOTE: this will not work on saves made before the 1.02 update).
[*] Expanded lumber loading facility visuals have been updated to match the regular lumber loading.
[*] Highway and access road positions were incorrect in some expanded loading facilities and have now been corrected.
[*] The logo has been changed to display on utility facilities outside of the region border.
[*] A few environmental decoration changes were made in the deluxe edition Vaporville sandbox map.
[*] Some text changes and typos have been cleaned up.
[/list]

We’re continuing to monitor feedback and are committed to making ongoing improvements. If you have any other bugs to report, please do so in the Discord server so the devs can address the issues as quickly as possible. 

Your support, feedback and patience have been invaluable as we work to refine and improve the game post-launch, thank you.

notes.title: Contracts Hotfix
notes.content:

Please stay tuned for future updates and fixes.

notes.title: Get ready to build, trade, and dominate industries this June
notes.content:
Get ready for a rich and immersive tycoon experience, as Rise of Industry 2 will officially launch on June 3rd, 2025.

Building on the success of its predecessor, Rise of Industry 2 introduces bold new ideas to the boardroom with a sleek 1980s inspired art style, new gameplay mechanics, and fresh features designed for both aspiring entrepreneurs and tycoon fans alike. 

[h3][b]What’s New in Rise of Industry 2?[/b][/h3]

[b]All-New Campaign Mode[/b]
Conquer 15 unique and exciting scenarios as you rise through the corporate ranks.

[b]Expanded Sandbox Mode[/b]
Build the industrial empire of your dreams with complete freedom.

[b]Dynamic Social Systems[/b]
Network with CEOs, trade materials, and gain introductions to powerful industry leaders.

[b]Stylised 1980s Visuals[/b]
A brand new art direction captures the decade’s bold aesthetic with neon lights, sharp suits, and more!

Join the conversation on our official [url=https://discord.gg/gt77AEHQuP]Discord server[/url] to connect with fellow tycoons, and follow us on [url=https://x.com/RiseOfIndustry]Twitter/X[/url] for the latest updates, tips, and sneak peeks.

Wishlist Rise of Industry 2 today and be first in line to build your dream empire!
